title: CAPEX single-sheet direction characterization
base_sha_start_note: post-57F, UI-3.2 next-grid readiness plan merged
user_feedback: The app should NOT have two CAPEX views (CAPEX Summary + CAPEX Detail / Excel reconciliation). The desired product direction is ONE Excel-like CAPEX sheet, similar to the source Excel model.

view_A_capex_summary.editability_user_project: data rows editable; data_financing / subtotal / total / delta_warning read-only
view_A_capex_summary.sheet_banner: 🏗️ CAPEX Detail (note: mislabel; should be 'CAPEX Summary')

view_B_capex_detail.editability_user_project: line item names and amounts editable; payment schedule and WHT derived (backend-computed)
view_B_capex_detail.editability_factory_reference: all cells read-only with 'backend' badge for runtime-calculated values

why_two_views_are_confusing: Same tab, two competing surfaces, both labeled '🏗️ CAPEX Detail' (banner mislabel)
Different levels of detail, different editability
Different data sources (capex_items vs capex_detail_items); not guaranteed in sync
Different update paths; changes to one view do not propagate to the other
Two competing visual hierarchies (compact 3-column vs wide Excel-like)

user_target_capex_model.description: ONE Excel-like CAPEX sheet, similar to the source Excel model

gap_analysis.summary_view_A: lacks cost per MW, contingency, VAT, WHT, depreciation, comments, test/status, payment schedule, utilisation, future IDC basis
gap_analysis.detail_view_B: has all target columns except 'future IDC basis' (which is new in 57A-2)
gap_analysis.target_single_sheet: promotes view B and adds 'future IDC basis' placeholder

recommended_direction: Promote the Detail view (B) to the single CAPEX sheet and remove or collapse the Summary view (A).
reasons_for_recommended_direction: Detail view (B) already has all target columns
Summary view (A) does not map to the source Excel model
Detail view (B) is closer to the source Excel model
57A LineItemGrid macro can be extended for view B's wider column set
Summary view (A)'s 57A work is not wasted; macro can be reused and extended

extensions_needed: long horizontal grids (M1..Mn payment schedule columns)
horizontal scroll or column grouping for wide grids

next_runtime_proposal_57a_3.objective: Turn CAPEX into a single Excel-like line-item sheet (promote view B, hide/collapse view A).

supersedes_57f_opex_recommendation_note: The 57F plan recommended OPEX as the next candidate. This 57A-2 direction correction supersedes that recommendation: the CAPEX single-sheet direction must be locked first, then the LineItemGrid macro must be extended, then 57A-3 single CAPEX sheet is the next runtime migration. OPEX/Revenue is deferred until after 57A-3 is locked.
